## Flujo completo de la lista paginada de Contributors

**Endpoint** — `List` (`src/Clean.Architecture.Web/Contributors/List.cs:8`) hereda `Endpoint<ListContributorsRequest, ContributorListResponse, ListContributorsMapper>`. `HandleAsync` (:49) hace `_mediator.Send(new ListContributorsQuery(request.Page, request.PerPage))` (:51), y si falla responde `Send.ErrorsAsync(statusCode: 400)` (:54); luego `AddLinkHeader(pagedResult.Page, pagedResult.PerPage, pagedResult.TotalPages)` (:59) y `Map.FromEntity(pagedResult)` (:61). Los parámetros llegan por bindings: `Page [BindFrom("page")]` (:90) y `PerPage [BindFrom("per_page")]` (:94).

**Abstracción** — `IListContributorsQueryService` (`src/Clean.Architecture.UseCases/Contributors/List/IListContributorsQueryService.cs:7`) define `Task<UseCases.PagedResult<ContributorDto>> ListAsync(int page, int perPage)` (:9). El handler la recibe por constructor: campo `private readonly IListContributorsQueryService _query` (`ListContributorsHandler.cs:5`).

**Handler** — `ListContributorsHandler : IQueryHandler<ListContributorsQuery, Result<PagedResult<ContributorDto>>>` (`ListContributorsHandler.cs:3`). `Handle` normaliza valores nulos: `_query.ListAsync(request.Page ?? 1, request.PerPage ?? Constants.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE)` (:16) y devuelve `Result.Success(result)` (:18). El query es `record ListContributorsQuery(int? Page = 1, int? PerPage = Constants.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE)` (`ListContributorsQuery.cs:3`). En DI, `AddInfrastructureServices` registra `IListContributorsQueryService → ListContributorsQueryService` (`src/Clean.Architecture.Infrastructure/InfrastructureServiceExtensions.cs:48`).

**Consulta real** — `ListContributorsQueryService.ListAsync` (`src/Clean.Architecture.Infrastructure/Data/Queries/ListContributorsQueryService.cs:17`) ejecuta contra el `DbSet<Contributor> Contributors` (`AppDbContext.cs:6`):
```csharp
_db.Contributors.FromSqlRaw("SELECT Id, Name, PhoneNumber_CountryCode, PhoneNumber_Number, PhoneNumber_Extension FROM Contributors")
  .AsNoTracking().OrderBy(c => c.Id)
  .Skip((page - 1) * perPage).Take(perPage)...ToListAsync()   // :19
```
más `_db.Contributors.CountAsync()` para totalCount (:27), `totalPages = (int)Math.Ceiling(totalCount / (double)perPage)` (:28), `new UseCases.PagedResult<ContributorDto>(items, page, perPage, totalCount, totalPages)` (:29).

**Fake** — `FakeListContributorsQueryService : IListContributorsQueryService` (`src/Clean.Architecture.Infrastructure/Data/Queries/FakeListContributorsQueryService.cs:7`). Su `ListAsync` (:9) no toca BD: crea una `List<ContributorDto>` en memoria (:11), bucle `for i = 1..25` (:12), `new PhoneNumber("+1", "555", "1234567")` (:14) e `items.Add(new ContributorDto(ContributorId.From(i), ContributorName.From($"Fake {i}"), phone))` (:15); calcula `totalPages = Math.Ceiling(items.Count / (double)perPage)` (:18) y devuelve `Task.FromResult(new PagedResult(items, page, perPage, items.Count, totalPages))` (:19-20). Se registra solo en testing: `RegisterTestingOnlyDependencies` del proyecto sample (`sample/src/NimblePros.SampleToDo.Infrastructure/InfrastructureServiceExtensions.cs:71`).
